name: Matsugae Fumiya
source:
The talented young scholar. 
Brilliant since childhood, he entered the Imperial University without difficulty, a beautiful youth blessed with both brains and looks. Extremely shy and reserved, his gentle nature and striking appearance make him liked by everyone. Well-versed in economics and gifted at reading the markets, he dabbles in stock trading as a hobby.

"I’m still inexperienced, but I’d be delighted if we could get along."

[Translated from [url=https://pil-vamp.jp/products/aizou/chara]the official website[/url].]
